Pending set is empty, so recovery requires revise_plan. Smallest safe next action: execute the already-archived script rotate_ch2o_geometry.py (artifact_2fe5ad55... , exactly known sha256) with sdk_orca=false, binding the qualified prepared geometry artifact as ch2o_original.xyz at its declared basename (no task-authored XYZ replacing the identity anchor). This produces the real rotated XYZ, the rotation matrix/convention record and the rotation_relation observation, which are prerequisites for the independent rotated ORCA job. ORCA input authoring/parsing is deliberately not attempted yet: the two static-polarizability tensors must come from real, separately executed ORCA jobs, and no ORCA output text has been inspected to justify a parser. Next round will bind the resulting ch2o_rotated.xyz artifact and plan the two independent ORCA calculations (identical RHF/def2-SVP gas-phase elprop settings, separate request keys), then a later analysis step for tensor-transform/isomer verification.
